title: http2 + wscbor: fix usage of composite tvb
description:
Prevents an exception in finalize if no tvbs are appended.http2 + wscbor: fix usage of composite tvb

# Summary
- Fix leak of `tvb_new_composite` in packet-http2.c
- Fix exception from `tvb_composite_finalize` in wscbor.c

# Background & Motivation

`tvb_new_composite` [documents](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/03cb1cb0773c304e616540050e3468ff239052aa/epan/tvbuff_composite.c#L186-189):

> The caller of tvb_new_composite MUST immediately call tvb_composite_append or tvb_composite_prepend to ensure that the composite TVB is properly freed as needed.


[doctored-http2.pcapng.error](/uploads/14a22ed891ca5090d45d5a85c5e44713/doctored-http2.pcapng.error) reproduces the leak in `packet-http2.c`. It was created by manually modifying a valid HTTP2 request to make an invalid header.

```
valgrind --leak-check=full \
        ./build/run/tshark -r doctored-http2.pcapng.error -V -d tcp.port==80,http2
```

`tvb_composite_finalize` [asserts there is at least one member](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/03cb1cb0773c304e616540050e3468ff239052aa/epan/tvbuff_composite.c#L273-277).

1446d3a9ef7fef43a1449095c1f0eb41fd263f6b adds a regression test to `wcsbor_test.c` with the test case `ex_bstr_indef_empty`. Before the fix, this test cases results in an exception when finalizing an empty composite tvb:

```
Unhandled exception ("epan/tvbuff_composite.c:277: failed assertion "num_members"", group=1, code=6)
.h/test.sh: line 5:  8027 Aborted                 (core dumped) ./build/run/wscbor_test
```
